recommendation: Keep the source fix. It restores the previously approved computable default on the current build-scope elements while preserving the later FHIR-23965 isExample/profile model.
issue_request: FHIR-13482 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested ImplementationGuide.package.resource.example be made 0..1 with a default of false because there is no useful unknown state for whether an IG-listed resource is an example.
initial_application: Historical git-svn commit 9ac87a33556212faffb63475f323c4fab59090b2, corresponding to svn revision 12721 cited in Jira, changed the old spreadsheet row from 1..1 to 0..1 and added Default Value = False. The current source had retained optional cardinality on renamed successor fields, but the formal default was absent.
additional_context: Current source/fhir.ini lists ImplementationGuide as an active resource, maps R3 ImplementationGuide.package.resource to ImplementationGuide.definition.resource, and maps later example[x] paths to isExample. FHIR-23965 later renamed/split exampleBoolean/exampleCanonical into isExample plus profile, and FHIR-I minutes record that decision, but no Jira, Zulip, or Confluence evidence found a decision to remove the false default.
reconciliation: Added defaultValueBoolean=false to ImplementationGuide.definition.resource.isExample and to the parallel ImplementationGuide.manifest.resource.isExample in source/implementationguide/structuredefinition-ImplementationGuide.xml.

related_jiras.note: Published later change that renamed/split ImplementationGuide resource.example[x] into isExample plus profile; it explains the current successor elements without reversing FHIR-13482's false default.
